title: Two wonderful days in Sevilla
text: Sofia is fantastic!  A multi-generational native of Sevilla, she shares her unsurpassed knowledge of the sites and general history of the area, and is engaging for all ages.
author: johnrpitts

title: Complete tour and still take pictures!
text: We did the tour in Portuguese and Sofia was excellent! He told the whole story, was very patient, answered all our questions and even took pictures!
author: soninhagc9

title: Exceeds expectations!
text:
Sofia took our first visit to Seville to the next level. She planned a perfect itinerary over two days that combined our specific interests with important monuments and sites that deepened the experience.

Sofia’s “super power “ is her ability to share her in depth knowledge in a way that is relatable and often personal. She pointed out so many interesting aspects of historical and cultural significance during our tours that helped us better understand the Seville culture. 

We highly recommend private tours with Sofia Ventura during your stay in Seville. She exceeds expectations!
author: heartinlaguna

title: Surprisingly
text: We loved the whole tour, everything was beautiful and our guide Sofia introduced us to Seville in a unique way, with a lot of knowledge, great fluency in Portuguese which greatly facilitated our understanding!
author: antonioaG6554LY

title: Beautiful Seville
text: It was a pleasure to have Sofia as our guide to this beautiful city. Born, raised and now a professional guide, Sofia had just the right mix of historical knowledge, warmth and humor. You will learn a lot and enjoy your time with her. Thank you Sofia!
author: Connie H

title: The Best Tour of Seville
text:
Our guide was extremely punctual, pleasant, helpful and very patient (our group had two children).

We did the entire tour on foot, starting with Alcazar, passing by the Cathedral and then going to the Triana neighborhood.

I highly recommend
author: andreapY92UG
